All songs composed by Hampus Granberg.

notes.title: Krystopia: Nova´s Journey
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36012744/b9d362ab7af4d249203be74a9e6b2ed456e331b5.png[/img]

Krystopia: Nova's Journey is a captivating new puzzle adventure where you'll explore and solve your way through a mysterious land full of intriguing secrets. In the role of space explorer Nova Dune, the player needs to observe the environment and navigate in a typical point and click-fashion to solve puzzles and progress through the game and figure out the mystery on the mesmerizing planet of Krystopia. The game is an independent sequel to Krystopia: A Puzzle Journey.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1225120/Krystopia_Novas_Journey/

[previewyoutube=c590sUoxY4g;full][/previewyoutube]

* Unique character based and story driven puzzle adventure
* Innovative, fun and challenging puzzles
* Immersive soundtrack & audio experience
* Unwind by watching and interacting with the beautiful surroundings of Krystopia
* Explore and resolve the mystery of Krystopia
* A mystery conveyed in a beautiful atmospheric setting.
* Collect unique and mysterious artifacts
* Encounter and interact with intriguing characters (some being complete buffoons...)

Krystopia: A Puzzle Journey has been nominated for 5 awards in the below categories at Game Connection America 2020ːsteamhappyː

* Best mobile / tablet game
* Best casual game
* Best visual art and design
* Best story / storytelling
